_On this day in 2002, the US launched its first major ground assault in
Afghanistan. This week is a stark reminder of how US military deployments have
somehow found ways to grow dumber and more maddening over the last two and a
half decades. Thanks for that, Donald the Dove._

Hi, it's **Swin** again. I don't have anything clever to say in this intro.
Every month, **Donald Trump** and his party find new ways to expand their
numerous unjustified, lethal wars (both abroad and right here at home), and
there aren't very many polite words left to use in chronicling the upsurge in
bloodbaths. I will, however, try my best, starting now.

In today's '**First Draft** ,' President Trump is getting a ton of people,
including **US military personnel** , killed and doesn't seem to give a shit,
he may have bit off more than he expected by taking out **Iran 's leader**,
and judges in deep-red West Virginia are warning about **ICE 's lawlessness**
at home. Plus, we bring you the latest from the US and Israel's **illegal
war** with Iran.

# 'He Doesn't Do Empathy'

The blood of American soldiers is [on his
hands](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/mar/01/trump-more-deaths-
military-iran), even as the entirety of the Republican Party elite will try to
wash it off with their scolding talking points. This was true when troops [got
shot in Washington, DC](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/11/26/us/politics/trump-
national-guard-dc-shooting.html), last year - troops who never should have
been there and were in DC _only_ because Donald Trump wanted a [power
grab](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/UCwH0PBJ-ws) in our nation's capital.

It is truer today as American families mourn the latest round of fallen
soldiers who did not have to die, and are only dead today because of the
Trump-Vance administration and its bottomless appetite for wars that never had
to happen and that a staggering majority of Americans openly do not want.

So far, Trump's regime-change blitz on Iran - a war of aggression for which
there is [no clear mission](https://zeteo.com/p/an-illegal-war-iran-trump-
first-draft)
[whatsoever](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/01/us/politics/trump-iran-war-
interview.html) - has gotten hundreds of Iranians, including [scores of
schoolgirls](https://zeteo.com/p/gaza-iran-children-minab-killed-western-
imperialism-israel-us), killed in addition to [four US
troops](https://x.com/CENTCOM/status/2028446849078530280) killed and several
others wounded, according to initial reports on Iranian retaliation. The US
president is attempting to front-run _future_ stories of dead American
soldiers being flown home to grieving loved ones, and issued a video address
telling the American public that **" there will likely be more"** of these
deaths in the **" righteous" **war that he and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin
Netanyahu have plunged us into.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

I highly encourage each of you to watch the fuller
[video](https://bsky.app/profile/meidastouch.com/post/3mfzo4vgaac2t) from
Trump. It is genuinely chilling. At one point, it looks like the guy starts to
smirk when talking about how likely it is that the American body count will
further increase.

**" Sadly, there will likely be more before it ends,"** the president says.
**" That's the way it is."**

Elsewhere, Trump [told](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/01/us/politics/trump-
iran-war-interview.html) the _New York Times_ on Sunday, **" Three is three
too many as far as I'm concerned. If you look at projections, they do
projections, it could be quite a bit higher than that."** He added, **" We
expect casualties."**

Too often, it feels as though we are living in a [Paul Verhoeven
movie](https://www.cracked.com/article_19259_6-mind-blowing-ways-starship-
troopers-predicted-future.html), where a mentally declining, physically
deteriorating reality-TV-show personality turned wannabe god emperor is doing
a full court press to convince you to feel grateful for the mass death and
American casualties he's causing.

Trump and the horrendous gang running our federal government are barely even
trying to pretend that they care about the soldiers they've needlessly sent to
their deaths, and the other service members who they think they'll be sending
to die tomorrow.

Over the weekend, I reached out to various Trump advisers, past and present,
to ask them why this president often seems so callous when officially
addressing the killing of his fellow countrymen and compatriots. Some got
defensive. Others retained a modicum of self-awareness, including a senior
administration official who told me: **" He doesn't do empathy."**

He will never admit that these deaths were his own damn fault. But by his own
stated rules, Trump's hands are caked in the blood of the fallen soldiers. In
early 2024, Trump blamed then-President Joe Biden for a drone attack that
killed three US service members in Jordan,
[posting](https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/4434384-trump-blames-
bidens-weakness-and-surrender-for-deadly-drone-attack-that-killed-3-us-
troops/) to social media that the **" brazen attack on the United States is
yet another horrific and tragic consequence of Joe Biden's weakness and
surrender."**

But Biden did not start that conflict. Trump unilaterally started this. Even
playing by Trump's rules, it makes infinitely more sense to say the recent war
deaths are Trump's fault than there ever was for Trump to blame Biden for
virtually anything.

The sitting president is an elderly man. Until his last breath, he should
_never_ be allowed to forget that _he_ got them killed… even if he never feels
a glimmer of remorse or self-reflection.

## **🇮 🇷 **Iran War Updates

  * **Death tolls:** The [death toll](https://apnews.com/live/iran-us-israel-hezbollah-strikes-03-02-2026#0000019c-adb6-d0c7-adbe-efbf8af70000) in Iran from the US and Israel's illegal war has climbed to **more than 550** , the country's Red Crescent said today, including 165 people - mostly young school girls - in Minab. **Four US troops** have been killed, and four others are seriously injured. **Dozens** have been killed in other countries across the region, including more than [30 in an Israeli attack](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/2/israel-bombs-beirut-after-hezbollah-launches-rocket-attack) on the Lebanese capital, Beirut, and 10 in [Iranian strikes](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/1/at-least-nine-killed-after-iranian-strike-on-israels-beit-shemesh) in Israel. 

  * **Four to five more weeks:** Asked by the _[NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/01/us/politics/trump-iran-war-interview.html) _about how much longer the US and Israel could continue the current level of attacks on Iran, Trump said: "Well, we intended four to five weeks."

  * **Imminent threat?** According to CNN, the Pentagon [informed](https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/us-israel-iran-attack-03-01-26-intl?post-id=cmm8g18pb00003b6s68xqscio) congressional staff that Iran was not planning preemptive strikes against the US, contradicting earlier claims from the Trump administration.

  * **' Friendly fire': **Kuwait appeared to have mistakenly shot down three US F15 fighter jets, US Central Command [said](https://x.com/CENTCOM/status/2028424933794087326). All pilots successfully ejected. 

  * **' We won't negotiate': **Top Iranian security official Ali Larijani [said](https://x.com/alilarijani_ir/status/2028323835938832483) "we will not negotiate with the US" on Monday [amid reports](https://www.wsj.com/livecoverage/iran-israel-us-strikes-2026/card/iran-s-security-chief-says-tehran-will-not-negotiate-with-u-s--2MNBldfD9dyJwIYVHpz7) Tehran pushed to restart talks. 

  * **US can use UK bases:** UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer [said](https://x.com/Keir_Starmer/status/2028213832380826047) late Sunday he would allow the US to use British military bases for "defensive" strikes on Iranian missile sites, adding the UK has learned from the "mistakes of Iraq" and "will not join offensive action now." A runway at a [British base](https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/british-air-base-cyprus-hit-by-suspected-drone-strike-sky-news-reports-2026-03-02/) in Cyprus was reportedly hit in a drone strike on Monday.

  * **Lebanon bans Hezbollah activity:** The Lebanese government [banned](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/2/lebanese-pm-nawaf-salam-announces-ban-on-hezbollah-military-activities) Hezbollah's military and security activities today after Israel hit Beirut following an attack by Hezbollah in retaliation for the assassination of Iran's supreme leader. 

  * **Deadly clash in Pakistan:** More than 20 people [were killed](https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-protesters-attacked-us-consulate-karachi-iran-a3cc0c3c6f126cc54a657f61d312a203) in confrontations with police after pro-Iran protesters in Pakistan attempted to storm the US consulate in Karachi.

Melissa Bean, and state Senator Laura Fine - funneling the funds through super PACs and directing donors to candidate fundraising efforts.

  * **' The government is wrong': **In the deep red state of West Virginia, federal judges are [sounding](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/03/01/west-virginia-immigration-rulings-00804575) the alarm on ICE's unlawful detentions. One of the judges has now [warned](https://storage.courtlistener.com/recap/gov.uscourts.wvsd.243036/gov.uscourts.wvsd.243036.18.0.pdf) the administration: "Continued detention without individualized custody determinations, after this court's repeated holdings that such detention violates the Fifth Amendment, will result in legal consequences."

  * **Seeking return:** Trump illegally deported 137 Venezuelan immigrants to a notorious torture prison in El Salvador for months, before they were released as part of a prisoner swap with Venezuela. Now, 19 of those immigrants are [seeking](https://x.com/rparloff/status/2027747346155438485?s=46) to return to the US to [challenge](https://storage.courtlistener.com/recap/gov.uscourts.dcd.278436/gov.uscourts.dcd.278436.252.0.pdf) Trump's Tren de Aragua designation against them in court, even though it will mean getting detained by ICE.

  * **Abysmal polling:** Following Trump's strikes against Iran, a new poll found only 27% of Americans [approve](https://www.ipsos.com/en-us/more-americans-disapprove-approve-us-strikes-against-iran) of the military operation, with 43% disapproving and 29% not sure yet. The same poll found Trump with a 38% approval rating, and that his approval on key issues, ranging from immigration to the economy, is badly underwater.

## 🌏 Anywhere But America

  * **🇵 🇸 Don't forget Gaza: **Israel [closed all border crossings](https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/israel-closes-rafah-crossing-checkpoint-west-bank-gaza-strip) in the occupied West Bank and Gaza, including the Strip's Rafah crossing, which is vital for the delivery of humanitarian aid and is the only way for Palestinians in desperate need of medical treatment to leave the enclave. As Iran's missiles are fired toward Israel, most Palestinians in the West Bank, who are facing severe restrictions on movement, have no way of sheltering. 

  * **🇦 🇷 Argentina passes anti-worker bill**: Argentina's senate [passed](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/2/28/argentina-senate-approves-contentious-milei-backed-labour-reforms) the "labor modernization law," an anti-labor rights bill - backed by far-right President Javier Milei - that restricts worker strikes, softens hiring practices, and allows for longer working days. Major labor unions in the country are set to protest the new reforms today in Buenos Aires.

  * **🌎 Oil prices set to spike**: Trump's war in Iran is putting the global energy market in jeopardy, with Iran warning boats not to cross through the Strait of Hormuz, and three boats attacked so far. Oil prices [rose](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/01/business/energy-environment/iran-war-oil-prices.html) by as much as 13% and reached up to $82 a barrel at one point yesterday.

## 📺 Sunday Show Roundup

  * Democratic Senator **Mark Kelly** bombed the test when he was asked whether he'd support a War Powers resolution to require that military action against Iran be approved by Congress, [saying](https://x.com/atrupar/status/2028134866454303056?s=46&t=uXB-axTQSod3D2EIebJYlQ) it was "rather unlikely" on NBC's 'Meet the Press.' He [changed](https://x.com/senmarkkelly/status/2028166627015934025?s=46&t=uXB-axTQSod3D2EIebJYlQ) his tune shortly after, coming out in support of the resolution. 

  * On the other side, the GOP seemingly wants to cede all power to King Trump. Republican Senator **Lindsey Graham** [told](https://x.com/atrupar/status/2028133805358264584?s=46&t=uXB-axTQSod3D2EIebJYlQ) NBC's Kristen Welker that Congress should _not_ vote on approving Trump's war on Iran, and even went as far as to make the absurd claim that the War Powers Act is "unconstitutional."

  * On 'Meet the Press,' Democratic Rep. **Ro Khanna** [called](https://x.com/atrupar/status/2028135642220073213?s=46&t=uXB-axTQSod3D2EIebJYlQ) out Trump for his sheer hypocrisy in waging his war in Iran while also being a harsh critic of past military operations. "He ran because a big part of the MAGA base did not want another war in the Middle East… I believe this is a betrayal of a decent chunk of the MAGA base," Khanna told Kristen Welker.

  * And, if you're looking for a masterclass in gaslighting, look no further than GOP Senator **Markwayne Mullin** on CNN. When asked about how Americans will respond to the military deaths from Trump's war with Iran, the Oklahoma senator [deflected](https://x.com/acyn/status/2028195343230452170?s=46&t=uXB-axTQSod3D2EIebJYlQ) from the question, claiming the US is not engaged in a war… even though the US has bombed the country, sunk its ships, killed hundreds, and assassinated its leader.
